local function Bound(label,body,seconds)
 local started=os.clock();local deadline=started+seconds -- BEFORE worker construction/launch
 local finished,result,failure=false,nil,nil
 local worker=launchOwned(function()
  local ok,value=pcall(body);if ok then result=value else failure=value end;finished=true
 end)
 while not finished and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait()end
 if not finished then
  local dead,reason=cancelOwned(worker)
  assert(dead,label.." could not stop worker: "..tostring(reason))
  error(label.." exceeded original bound; worker confirmed dead")
 end
 assert(coroutine.status(worker)=="dead",label.." returned before owned worker stopped")
 assert(os.clock()-started<=seconds,label.." initial/synchronous work exceeded wall deadline")
 if failure~=nil then error(tostring(failure))end
 return result
end
